# function: promql

Compiles a DQL query, written in the stated grammar version or the latest, into a PromQL expression.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "mock_request_rate" {
  value = provider::dql::promql("__name__:mock_requests_total and env:mock | rate(5m) | sum() by job")
}

output "mock_request_rate_grammar_1_0" {
  value = provider::dql::promql("__name__:mock_requests_total and env:mock | rate(5m) | sum() by job", "1.0")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
promql(query string, grammar_version string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `query` (String) The DQL query.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `grammar_version` (Variadic, String) The grammar version the query is written in, `<major>.<minor>`; omitted, the latest the provider supports.
